comment:
* Flag names for configuring the zygote.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: USAP_POOL_ENABLED
variables.comment: If {@code true}, enables the unspecialized app process (USAP) pool feature

variables.name: USAP_POOL_ENABLED_DEFAULT
variables.comment:
* The default value for enabling the unspecialized app process (USAP) pool.  This value will
     * not be used if the devices has a DeviceConfig profile pushed to it that contains a value for
     * this key or if the System Property dalvik.vm.usap_pool_enabled is set.

variables.name: USAP_POOL_REFILL_THRESHOLD
variables.comment: The threshold used to determine if the pool should be refilled

variables.name: USAP_POOL_SIZE_MAX
variables.comment: The maximum number of processes to keep in the USAP pool

variables.name: USAP_POOL_SIZE_MAX_LIMIT
variables.comment:
* The maximim value that will be accepted from the USAP_POOL_SIZE_MAX device property.
     * is a mirror of USAP_POOL_MAX_LIMIT found in com_android_internal_os_Zygote.cpp.

variables.name: USAP_POOL_SIZE_MIN
variables.comment: The minimum number of processes to keep in the USAP pool

variables.name: USAP_POOL_SIZE_MIN_LIMIT
variables.comment: * The minimum value that will be accepted from the USAP_POOL_SIZE_MIN device property.

variables.name: USAP_POOL_REFILL_DELAY_MS
variables.comment: The number of milliseconds to delay before refilling the USAP pool

methods.name: public static int getInt(String name, int defaultValue)
methods.comment: * Get a property value from SystemProperties and convert it to an integer value.

methods.name: public static boolean getBool(String name, boolean defaultValue)
methods.comment: * Get a property value from SystemProperties and convert it to a Boolean value.

methodNames: public static int getInt(String name, int defaultValue)
